# Workbook drift allowlist (EC-S11, Sprint 3)
#
# One substring per non-blank, non-comment line. Drift lines reported by
# `valdo onboard-source --check` that contain ANY listed substring are
# tolerated; everything else fails the CI guardrail.
#
# CONVENTION: every entry MUST be accompanied by a comment immediately
# above it explaining (a) which workbook + artefact it covers and (b) why
# the drift is irreducible (link to an ADR / changelog entry / sprint
# story). Adding a bare substring with no rationale is a review-block.
#
# To remove an entry: ensure the underlying drift has actually been fixed
# in the workbook + emitter, run `scripts/check_workbook_drift.sh`
# locally, and only then delete the line.

# SHAW TRANERT_CUS hand-authored cross_row:sequential R028B countdown
# rule. The committed JSON uses the engine-native
# `sequence_field`/`start`/`step` shape that the BA workbook columns
# cannot express; documented as an irreducible carve-out by EC-S9 /
# EC-S10 and asserted by the
# `test_check_mode_clean_against_committed_state` regression test.
# See CHANGELOG.md entry for EC-S9 (Sprint 3 drift-fix).
